{{Top|leg}}
'''Holistic Data Transfers''', known as '''HDTs''', was a way of writing [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] in an information shorthand. Designed by a combination of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Programmer/Legends|programmers]], and [[computer linguist]]s, HDTs had an element of [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] built in, and the memory usage was small but sophisticated. HDTs allowed users to access more data on a given subject than was actually available by making informed "guesses" about the information it did possess. The more data the HDT had to work with, the more accurate the deduced information was.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> [[Portable computer]]s utilized Holistic Data Transfers to increase their storage capacity by a factor of one hundred.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
